import re
# Parse OCR by frame sections
text=open('/app/ocr_all.txt').read()
parts=re.split(r'===== (\d+) =====', text)
# parts[0] is before first header, then alternating number, content
frames=[]
for k in range(1,len(parts),2):
    t=int(parts[k])
    content=parts[k+1]
    frames.append((t,content))
# For each frame, print timestamp and command lines after >
with open('/app/frame_commands.txt','w') as out:
    for t,content in frames:
        cmds=re.findall(r'>(.*)', content)
        cmds=[c.strip() for c in cmds if c.strip()]
        if cmds:
            out.write(f'{t}: ' + ' | '.join(cmds) + '\n')
